title: Turbo Team Racing
desc: Turbo Team Racing is a fast-paced top-down arcade racing game inspired by classic retro racers. Master tight corners, avoid damage, collect power-ups and push your car to the limit across different tracks and weather conditions. Beat your best lap times, challenge your rivals and enjoy pure arcade speed with simple controls and addictive gameplay.

tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
